packages.name: Reconcile the receiving build and preserve scope
steps: Read AGENTS.md and current native governance instructions. Record git status, exact HEAD/tree and unrelated changes.
Compare receiving code to the reviewed main; classify already-fixed/new/different behavior without restoring an older tree.
Run packet integrity verification, obtain/build an exact current artifact and record SHA-256. Reproduce baseline failures; retain negative evidence.
packages.closure: Receiving identity, scoped branch, current gate evidence and reviewed acceptance oracles.

packages.name: Repair interaction ownership
steps: One owner edits editor/workspace scroll, status, focus and completion boundaries.
Implement section-specific scroll intent and a no-tab completion focus fallback.
Bind resolved failure feedback to its operation/session; cover ordinary success and delayed/session-switch feedback.
Add integrated keyboard and fail-fix-success sequences using production components.
packages.closure: A01-A06 and A15-A17 pass on identified artifact; no regression to drafts, Back or positive-control F2.

packages.name: Disclose collateral scenario removal
steps: Read removal implementation and schema cascade, not just UI wording.
Prepare exact removal consequences and revalidate relevant proposal identity before commit.
Keep simple independent removal light; protect unrelated pending metadata/builder input.
Prove Cancel and one-step Undo/Redo with a merge into an added service.
packages.closure: A07-A10 pass; no orphaned references or baseline mutations.

packages.name: Stabilize overview readability
steps: Use saved demo fixture before any randomized layout. Reproduce on approved Windows fonts and screenshot laptop sizes.
Design bounded label placement/priority without silently moving saved nodes or shrinking text below readability.
Extend quality checks to network/CDS heading intersections; retain current quality gates.
Review actual PNG/SVG and live As-Is/To-Be/Compare/focus states.
packages.closure: A11-A14 pass with meaningful visual review, exact native/font identity and no position/history changes.

packages.name: Clean developer output and delivery wording
steps: Tighten notice-document selection while retaining real licenses/attribution and escaping.
Add maintenance-script exclusion and fail-closed missing-license fixtures.
Correct preview/release wording using actual release metadata. Prepare, but do not publish, an owner-approved candidate path.
packages.closure: A18-A20 pass; no unauthorized release or removed required notices.

packages.name: Integrate and obtain remaining acceptance
steps: Run the repository current full gate and new regressions; retain exact compiled candidate and reports.
Reconcile all original 180 cases against current repository evidence without resetting or fabricating their statuses.
Complete native file/recovery, real zoom/AT and uncoached participant checks on approved environments.
Perform independent receiving review and record remaining limits. Stop before merge/tag/release unless separately authorized.
packages.closure: A21-A25, current exact-artifact evidence and owner decision. Green automated tests alone are not human or native sign-off.
